review_limits: Read-only archive parsing, hashing, source/manifest/license inspection and retained graph traversal only; no Cargo/build script/numerical/backend execution.
All 33 exact cached crate archives and retained materials were byte checked; this is not an independent proof of every contributor's title or historical code provenance.
Full grant/license/notice terms and selected source passages were inspected; complete source bodies were hashed, not semantically audited in full.
The 213 retained notice files are selected by the collector and are not an exhaustive census across all file types.
Four original complete-tree receipts and a new glam complete-tree lookup were checked; no claim of complete-tree retrieval for every package.
Official web references were read; their mutable HTML bytes were not retained. Actual license terms are pinned by the crate/upstream text hashes.
Linux/macOS metadata graphs are captured package reachability observations, not compilation, linking, MSRV or numerical results.
All-target metadata contains cfg(any()) and other conditional nodes; it is not one realizable 33-package target build.
No dependency adoption, project Cargo edit, service/workflow control, commit, push, or source change outside the two owned review files.
